ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of low-intensity dark pixels to high-intensity white focal points and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigmentation across the entire visible ventral field with dense white mottling concentrated at the distal tips and scattered high-contrast linear disruptions across the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 70 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing boundary, featuring numerous low-amplitude peaks and valleys with distinct jagged notches on the left lobe distal half.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature along the outer edges leading to sharp, tapered distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of small circular white points (barnacle attachment scars) located primarily along the trailing edges and the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional white linear scratches (rake marks), most prominent as a series of parallel lines in the center-left and center-right quadrants.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant surface rake-mark scarring and minor irregular indentations along the trailing edge indicative of previous mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A particularly dense cluster of high-intensity white pixels forming a solid patch at the extreme left distal tip.
